ELK / elkjs 0.12.0

The packages include elk-worker.js, copied without changes from
elkjs/lib/elk-worker.min.js, and bundled elkjs API code.
The npm manifest declares: EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later.
The upstream license text is retained in LICENSE.md beside this notice.
This notice does not select the workstation project license.

Source and build instructions:
https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/ff5771d7165445c42c408bb8a090c8035272218c
This is the gitHead reported by npm for elkjs 0.12.0.
License source (copied without changes):
https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/blob/ff5771d7165445c42c408bb8a090c8035272218c/LICENSE.md
ELK Java sources used by the upstream build:
https://github.com/eclipse/elk
See the pinned elkjs build.gradle and upstream build instructions for source inputs.
The upstream CI at this elkjs revision selects ELK master. The npm gitHead
identifies elkjs, not the exact ELK Java source commit. Exact Java source
provenance remains a release-review item in issue #37.

Retain this notice and LICENSE.md when you distribute the worker or bundles.
Other dependencies can have separate terms. This notice does not clear a release.
